path_encoding_preflight_fix: 2026-05-25: NewPC-Preflight.ps1 and Test-TrustedPC.ps1 no longer interpolate non-ASCII project paths into embedded Python; they load config from the package root.
uv_trampoline_fix: 2026-05-25: The package now bundles the full Kimi CLI Python 3.13 tool runtime and KimiCliProvider prefers python -m kimi_cli, avoiding uv trampoline shims that point to old absolute paths.
one_click_patch: FIX_KIMI_TRAMPOLINE_ONECLICK.bat / Patch-Fix-KimiTrampoline.ps1 repair older extracted copies on a new PC.
